title: Chassidishe Segulah Success
body: A 25-year-old yeshiva bochur from Yeshiva Kiryas Melech, Shmuel Aharon Chazan, participated in a Chassidishe segulah for shidduchim and is now engaged, celebrating the milestone on Zos Chanukah 5786.

title: NY Governor Saves Brooklyn Shul
body: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul halts demolition of historic Kingsbrook Shul in Brooklyn's East Flatbush neighborhood, built in 1950 on former hospital grounds.
